basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6+ years shipping production systems across e-commerce, SaaS, and AI, including React frontends, GraphQL APIs, and event-driven pipelines. Currently building storefront UI at Express; recently shipped Odin, a self-hosted multi-agent runtime with persistent memory, 50+ tools, and a nightly self-improvement loop on the Anthropic Messages API.

highlights: Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Webpack, Jest, React Testing Library, Apollo Server, Apollo Client, GCP, GitHub Actions, Adobe Launch, CommerceTools API
Own the product carousel, rebuilt from the ground up with an optimized component architecture that cut render cycles and improved core web vitals scores site-wide.
Lead integration of Google Retail Search, replacing keyword matching with ML-ranked results and improving search-to-conversion rates.
Enforce 100% unit test coverage across owned components using Jest and React Testing Library, catching regressions before they reach staging.
Maintain the Express open-source project, triaging issues, reviewing PRs, and coordinating releases with external contributors.
Mentor junior engineers through code review and pairing, with two direct reports moving into independent feature ownership.
Hold on-call rotation responsibilities, leading incident response and postmortem documentation for production issues.
Tech Stack: React, Bootstrap, Stripe, Node.js, TypeScript, GCP, Firebase
Architected and delivered the initial product from zero — designed data models, built the frontend, and shipped the first paying customer integration.
Built, tested, and deployed GCP Cloud Functions handling payment webhooks, user lifecycle events, and async task processing.
Integrated Stripe for subscription billing including webhook handling, failed payment recovery, and plan upgrade flows.

Went beyond scripted troubleshooting to resolve high-volume inbound issues on the first call, walking non-technical and elderly customers through setup step by step and consistently earning top-tier customer satisfaction scores.

projects.name: Odin — Self-Hosted Agent Runtime
projects.description: Multi-agent AI orchestrator built on the Anthropic Messages API. Features a seven-agent pipeline (Týr → Muninn → Heimdall → Huginn → Hermod → Norns), BullMQ async job processing, persistent memory via an Obsidian vault, 50+ specialized tools, and a nightly Kvasir self-improvement loop that analyzes traces, versions prompts, and gates its own changes. Takes a spec and opens a pull request. Runs research tasks that span hours without user intervention.
